propositions: Direct Anthropic fallback arms must be enabled in rebar.toml for frontier and standard model classes, with direct Anthropic Sonnet fallback paired to Bedrock Sonnet primary.

The existing whole-chain capability intersection mechanism silently degrades primary model capabilities to the intersection of all candidates; configuring a direct-Anthropic fallback on standard-class moves all calls from native to prompted structured output despite the primary supporting native.

Live testing confirmed direct Anthropic claude-sonnet-4-6 supports native structured output both with and without thinking, resolving the prior fail-closed capability asymmetry via measured exact-ID metadata.
Trivial-class must remain single-arm (Bedrock Haiku only) until direct Haiku native-output capability parity is measured.
Mixed Bedrock/Anthropic chains must conservatively disable prompt caching because provider cache styles differ.
Per-attempt capability resolution (rather than up-front intersection) is an approved superseding design that the chain mechanism currently does not support and is deferred as future work.
